name: sol_token_nfe1_4
description: Missing ownership check in transferFrom allows abuse of others' NFT approvals
question: The source file in `source` defines a function that transfers an ERC721/1155 token using a `from` (or equivalent owner) parameter which is not checked to equal `msg.sender`, nor validated to be an approved operator acting on behalf of the actual token owner, allowing any caller who holds an approval for a different token or context to move tokens they do not own, excluding functions that correctly verify msg.sender is the owner or an approved operator/spender before transferring.
criteria: A transfer function takes a `from` address parameter and calls the underlying token transfer using that `from` value without checking `from == msg.sender`
A function reuses a stored approval or allowance intended for one token/operation to authorize transfer of a different token owned by another user
Bulk/batch transfer logic iterates over token IDs and moves them from arbitrary owners using only a single caller-supplied approval check that does not bind to the specific token's actual owner
A wrapper or proxy transfer function forwards `from` to `transferFrom` internally without re-validating that msg.sender is the owner or an approved operator of that specific token
